system.description:
A two-meter shoulder-mounted limb carrying a miniature laspistol powered by the tech-priest's potentia coil; it counts as a laspistol.

It can fire as a Reaction or as a normal weapon during an attack action, but only once per round either way. Only tech-priests can use mechadendrites, up to a number equal to their Constitution.
system.effectText: Counts as a laspistol; fire as reaction or normal attack, but only once per round.
